description: This file defines an abstract class for map layers and several concrete implementations for different map providers (OpenStreetMap, Google, Tencent, Here, Custom). It manages loading map layers, including reference styles, and handles external dependencies such as Leaflet, RxJS, and map style resources.

classes.name: TbMapLayer
classes.description: Abstract base class for different map layer implementations, providing methods to load and generate map layers, including reference layers.

classes.name: TbOpenStreetMapLayer
classes.description: Concrete implementation of TbMapLayer for OpenStreetMap using tileLayer.provider.

classes.name: TbGoogleMapLayer
classes.description: Concrete implementation of TbMapLayer for Google Maps, handling API loading and map layer creation.

classes.name: TbTencentMapLayer
classes.description: Concrete implementation of TbMapLayer for Tencent maps using chinaProvider.

classes.name: TbHereMapLayer
classes.description: Concrete implementation of TbMapLayer for Here maps with provider options.

classes.name: TbCustomMapLayer
classes.description: Concrete implementation of TbMapLayer for custom tile URLs.

methods.name: fromSettings
methods.description: Static factory method to create specific map layer instances based on provider type.

methods.name: loadLayer
methods.description: Loads the map layer and optional reference layer, returning observable layer data.

methods.name: generateLayer
methods.description: Creates the base map layer and optionally combines it with a reference layer.

methods.name: loadReferenceLayer
methods.description: Loads a reference style layer based on style URL and style specification.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Generates the display title for the layer, using translation if available.

methods.name: generateTitle
methods.description: Generates a default title if no label is set.

methods.name: createLayer
methods.description: Abstract method to create the specific map layer, implemented in subclasses.
